Rules and Agreement

Read every rule below. You must press I Agree to continue.

  1. Strata Invoice is a platform only. It is only a connection between you and your customer. It is not part of your business deals.
  2. Transactions are between you and your customer. Every conversation, quotation, invoice, receipt and payment is between the two of you. Strata Invoice and the admin are not part of them and have nothing to do with them.
  3. No part in payment or non-payment. Strata Invoice is not part of any payment, part-payment, late payment or non-payment between you and your customer.
  4. No power to check. Strata Invoice has no power to check, verify or control what happens between you and your customer, including whether money was paid, received, owed or never paid.
  5. Strata Invoice does not hold your money. It does not take, hold or move payments. Payments go directly between you and your customer.
  6. You are responsible for what you enter. Check amounts, tax, customer details and banking details before you save or send.
  7. Disputes and losses. Strata Invoice and the admin are not responsible for disputes, delivery problems, bad service, non-payment or any loss between you and your customer.
  8. No checking of people. Strata Invoice does not check the identity, honesty or ability to pay of you or your customer.
  9. Not professional advice. Strata Invoice does not give legal, tax or accounting advice. Tax rates and amounts on your documents are your responsibility.
  10. Subscription price and bonus. The subscription is R120 for 30 days. As a first-time subscriber you also receive a once-off 7-day opening bonus, making your first period 37 days in total. The opening bonus is given once only and never repeats. Every later subscription is 30 days for R120. When your time ends, your modules are locked until you pay.
  11. Keep your PIN private. Strata Invoice will never ask you for it. Anything done with your PIN is treated as done by you.
  12. Your email is for your PIN. If you lose your PIN, you can reset it with the email and ID number you gave when you signed up. Keep that email correct.
  13. Your records stay on your device. Save and back up your documents regularly. Strata Invoice cannot recover records you delete or lose.
  14. Use it lawfully. Only use Strata Invoice for real, lawful business. Do not use it for false or misleading documents. Access may be stopped if it is misused.
  15. No guarantee of service. Strata Invoice is provided as it is. It may be slow, change or be unavailable at times, and nothing is guaranteed.
  16. Rules can change. If the rules or the price change, you will be told before the change applies.
  17. Your agreement. Pressing I Agree means you accept all of these rules.

Payments ledger

Every payment you confirm is recorded here. Revenue counts only payments marked verified with a bank or provider reference. Pending and failed payments are tracked until you verify them.

Customers

Name, account, registration date, access status and payment history. Customer documents are never shown here.

Module monitor

The test buttons open each module out of sight in demo and paid mode and check that it loads, shows no script errors or invalid numbers, shows or omits the demo watermark correctly, and can use browser storage. They do not press Save, PDF, WhatsApp or email. Confirm those by hand on your phone and record the result in the right-hand columns. Your saved data is put back after each test.

Shared data and storage

Technical errors

Errors are caught while modules run: the error, what was clicked just before, the time and diagnostic details. Use Reproduce to open the module, then run its test again after a correction and mark the entry fixed only once it passes.

Owner audit record

Recent owner actions and sign-ins. PINs, bank details and customer documents are never written here.

Client Messages — Owner Inbox 0 unread

Messages and replies stored on this browser. Cross-device delivery is not active until Firebase is configured and secured.

Firebase connection readiness — not connected
  1. Register the Strata Invoice web app in your Firebase project.
  2. Enable Firebase Authentication and link customer accounts to verified user IDs.
  3. Create Firestore collections for supportThreads and supportMessages.
  4. Deploy security rules so customers can access only their own threads and the verified owner can manage support.
  5. Connect and test the web configuration, then verify a message and reply across two separate devices.
Do not put service-account private keys or admin credentials in this HTML file. A secure server function is required for privileged AI repair operations.
